title: XOR.DDoS_Botnet_Investigation_d15
description: Investigate and contain a potential botnet threat in the organization's network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The organization has detected unusual network traffic patterns originating from several internal systems. Initial analysis suggests these systems may be participating in a botnet. Your task is to investigate and contain this potential threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: Check running services and look for unusual network connections. The suspicious service is likely named 'bot-beacon.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and look for unusual network connections.

levels.title: Determine Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server?
levels.solution: Investigate network connections and look for unusual destinations. The command-and-control server is likely at IP address 192.168.70.5.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate network connections and look for unusual destinations.

levels.title: Identify Attack Target
levels.content:
Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the system being targeted by the flood attack?
levels.solution: Analyze network traffic patterns to identify the attack target. The target system is likely at IP address 192.168.80.100.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Analyze network traffic patterns to identify the attack target.
